Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism table linked to compound_records for substrate and parent compound names and to compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter for enzyme_name equal to CYP2B6. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit to 200 rows.
